answer: The orchard schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the copper checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 65 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Anyone wanting 183 effective identities must lock that capital for 65 epochs and keep it locked through every umber audit. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
